title.zh: Google发布Gemini API CLI，让 Claude Code、Codex直接调用生图、视频等能力
title.en: Google发布Gemini API CLI，让 Claude Code、Codex直接调用生图、视频等能力

current_state.zh: Google AI Studio released an open-source Gemini API CLI that allows Claude Code, Codex and other AI agents to call Gemini's image, video, speech, PDF and Deep Research capabilities directly from the command line after configuring only an API key.
current_state.en: Google AI Studio released an open-source Gemini API CLI that allows Claude Code, Codex and other AI agents to call Gemini's image, video, speech, PDF and Deep Research capabilities directly from the command line after configuring only an API key.
